changelog:
白い熊 店 4.8.4+014
• Fixes the sign-in loop that could pin the app on its splash screen: when the Google account had been removed from the phone, microG's “Allow … privileged access?” dialog came back every time you tapped Allow, with no way forward
• A saved sign-in that can no longer be refreshed is dropped, so the login buttons come back instead of a dialog you cannot get past
• Denying that dialog no longer crashes the app
• “Use microG to sign in to accounts” now applies to an existing sign-in too, not only to the login button
• An account left with no token no longer counts as signed in
